title: Carry a pinned Cargo executable through the Windows pack toolchain boundary
description: Prerequisite split from task-f1f8ac7895e249b786817e9c2f611c0c after plan-time measurement proved its exact seven-file rail cannot safely build the native broker inside the commit-materialized pack. At HEAD e76812730b8820a28a48c02b40bb5ce7af3f926c, WindowsPackToolchain carries only node/pnpm/powershell; packWindowsFromCommit passes that exact manifest; child PATH is rebuilt only from git/tar/node/pnpm/powershell directories; host Cargo is C:/Users/Yaron/.cargo/bin/cargo.exe and the pinned toolchain Cargo is under .rustup, disjoint from every trusted directory. Ambient PATH, USERPROFILE and CARGO_HOME are stripped. This row lands the missing authenticated Cargo carrier after candidate-pack task-a73b6872e13248768bc161d6059d6a0f finishes its shared pack-windows-main paths. Owned paths (7): tools/packaging/pack-tool-identity.ts; tools/packaging/pack-command.ts; tools/packaging/pack-command.test.ts; tools/packaging/pack-windows-main.ts; tools/packaging/pack-windows-main.test.ts; tools/packaging/toolchain-pins.ts; tools/packaging/toolchain-pins.json. Consumer task-f1f8ac7895e249b786817e9c2f611c0c must declare this row in dependsOn.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK: from the landed candidate-pack tree, prove whether the exact WindowsPackToolchain manifest and sanitized child PATH still omit Cargo; if another row already landed an equivalent authenticated Cargo carrier, adopt and verify it rather than duplicating it.

The frozen pack-tool/toolchain-pin schemas carry one Cargo PackToolLaunch resolved from the pinned Rust 1.96.0 toolchain, with exact executable identity and version/digest pins; missing, extra, malformed, wrong-version, wrong-digest, in-repository, symlinked, or changed Cargo refuses at the packaging toolchain layer with the existing stable PACK_STEP_FAILED code.

Serialization and parsing preserve exact key sets and immutable argv/identity witnesses; packWindowsFromCommit leases the Cargo executable and adds only its canonical external directory to the sanitized child PATH, with no ambient PATH, USERPROFILE, CARGO_HOME, shell, or command-string authority.

Focused tests assert both manifest directions and prove the materialized child can launch only the carried Cargo identity; substituting a same-name executable or mutating the Cargo digest reds the named refusal assertion.
The seven owned paths remain within production-file caps, focused packaging tests execute with nonzero Test Files/Tests counts, and pnpm typecheck:packaging exits 0.
taskRails: Owned paths are exactly the seven listed; task-a73b6872e13248768bc161d6059d6a0f must land before editing its shared pack-windows-main files.
Do not discover Cargo from ambient/user PATH inside the materialized child, weaken exact-key parsing, or trust a version string without the carried file identity.
Do not build or commit the broker executable here; this row carries tool authority only, and task-f1f8ac7895e249b786817e9c2f611c0c is the production consumer.
